newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market sees some roaster fixing.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market sees some roaster fixing.

text.p: German coffee consumers reappared this week and some roaster price fixing was noted as futures trended lower, Bremen traders said on Friday.
But roasters were reasonably well covered so that purchases were restricted to some spot and near-term Centralamericans and various African arabicas.
Arabica prices were mostly steady on the week but Salvador cst Nov shipment eased $1 to $115 fob per 50 kg and Kenyan new crop eased $2 to $134 while Costa Rica SHB rose $2 to $127.
In robustas, some Vietnamese and Indonesian differentials eased slightly, but Indonesian EK-1 was steady at $65 Oct cif.
